newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian Resources gold finds promising.
newsitem.headline: Australian Resources gold finds promising.

text.p: Gold miner Australian Resources Ltd said on Tuesday recent exploration had made it confident of an increase in its reserve and resource inventory.

The company said recent intersections at its Gidgee project in Western Australia had included 18 metres averaging 52 grams per tonne gold (g/t), 4.4 metres at 71.41 g/t, and nine metres averaging 48.01 g/t.
A resource estimate of the northern half of the deposit was in progress and drilling in the south continuing.
Meanwhile at Mt McClure in Western Australia, recent best intersections from drilling included 11 metres at 4.68 g/t and 26 metres at 3.84 g/t, Australian Resources said.

The Corbould deposit at Selwyn in Queensland returned excellent gold and copper grades, the company said, with best intersections including 13.1 metres at 6.2 g/t and 7.64 percent copper, 5.7 metres at 13.6 g/t and 9.8 percent copper and seven metres at 3.55 g/t and 3.31 percent copper.

Australian Resources shares dived with the rest of the gold sector after the bullion price kept its downward trend intact on Tuesday, but its shares bounced back from an intraday low of 30 cents to finish just two cents lower at 40 cents.
